note: Equipment records derived from NASA PSI hardware metadata fields (per-investigation) and registered NASA source pages. 3D models are labelled procedural schematics, never claimed as official CAD (spec R005).

equipment.name: Combustion Integrated Rack (CIR)
equipment.sourceNote: NASA Glenn CIR facility page (registered source nasa_fcf/nasa_combustion)
equipment.description: An ISS rack-level combustion facility that houses experiment-specific chamber inserts (ACME, MDCA), providing power, combustion air/nitrogen supply, avionics, imaging and diagnostics for microgravity flame experiments.
equipment.fidelityNote: Procedural schematic reconstruction from public facility descriptions; NOT official NASA CAD.

equipment.name: Fluids and Combustion Facility (FCF)
equipment.sourceNote: NASA Glenn FCF page (registered source nasa_fcf)
equipment.description: The ISS research facility comprising the Fluids Integrated Rack and the Combustion Integrated Rack, supporting physical sciences experiments aboard the station.
equipment.fidelityNote: Referenced via NASA facility documentation; no standalone model.

equipment.name: Multi-user Droplet Combustion Apparatus (MDCA)
equipment.description: A CIR chamber insert for droplet combustion: deployer needles/fiber position fuel droplets (methanol, heptane) in a quiescent test atmosphere with controlled pressure, O2 and diluent composition; cameras and radiometers record droplet regression and flame behaviour.
equipment.fidelityNote: Procedural schematic reconstruction; droplet deployment and imaging geometry simplified.

equipment.name: ACME Chamber Insert
equipment.description: The Advanced Combustion via Microgravity Experiments chamber insert in the CIR: a gas burner platform supporting configurable co-flow and inverse diffusion flame geometries (BRE, CLD, E-FIELD, s-Flame, Flame Design, CFI-G) with gas flow control, electric fields and diagnostics.
equipment.fidelityNote: Procedural schematic reconstruction of a co-flow/inverse burner geometry; not official CAD.

equipment.name: Microgravity Science Glovebox (MSG)
equipment.description: A sealed ISS glovebox work volume enabling small-scale interactive experiments — hosted BASS/BASS-II solid-fuel burning, SPICE smoke-point tests and DAFT aerosol feasibility measurements.
equipment.fidelityNote: Procedural schematic reconstruction of the glovebox work volume.

equipment.name: SPICE Co-flow Burner Insert
equipment.description: The Smoke Point In Co-flow Experiment insert: a round fuel nozzle in an annular co-flow of air within the MSG, used to measure smoke-point flame heights for different gaseous fuels and flow conditions.
equipment.fidelityNote: Procedural schematic reconstruction of nozzle + co-flow geometry.

equipment.name: SAFFIRE Instrumented Flow Duct
equipment.description: A large flow duct with instrumented sample cards flown inside the Cygnus pressurized cargo module after ISS departure, enabling the largest-in-history spacecraft fire-safety (flame growth/spread) experiments on realistic materials at vehicle scale.
equipment.fidelityNote: Procedural schematic reconstruction of the flow duct and sample card.

equipment.name: Comparative Soot Diagnostics Hardware
equipment.description: Instrument package used by SAME/SAME-R to characterize spacecraft smoke/aerosol from overheated materials, comparing detector responses (ionization vs photoelectric) and particle size distributions.
equipment.fidelityNote: Documented in NTRS records; no standalone 3D model.

equipment.name: TSI P-Trak Ultrafine Particle Counter
equipment.description: Commercial condensation particle counter used in the DAFT feasibility test to measure ultrafine aerosol concentrations in the ISS cabin environment.
equipment.fidelityNote: Commercial instrument documented in NTRS record; no model.
